summary_ja: OLCF Luxについて、4,000基超MI355X、500 node超、1.1 PB HBM、GPU当たり400G Ultra Ethernet、local NVMeと600 PB超Orion、Slurm/Kubernetes、partner最低175,000 node-hours/6か月を追加しました。稼働予定は現行頁の2026年10月へ更新しますが、仕様・理論値をacceptanceや実測性能とは扱いません。単一モデルによる暫定調査で、Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: For OLCF Lux, this update adds more than 4,000 MI355X GPUs, more than 500 nodes, 1.1 PB HBM, 400G Ultra Ethernet per GPU, local NVMe and the 600-plus-PB Orion system, Slurm/Kubernetes, and a partner minimum of 175,000 node-hours over six months. The current page moves the online target to October 2026, but specifications and theoretical figures are not treated as acceptance or measured performance. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

items.name_en: Lux AI+HPC system with more than 4,000 MI355X GPUs
items.timing_ja: OLCFは2026年10月稼働予定と表示
items.timing_en: OLCF currently displays an October 2026 online target
items.statement_ja: OLCFのsystem頁はLuxを500ノード超・4,000 GPU超のAMD MI355X systemとし、総HBM 1.1 PB、1 GPU当たり288 GB・8 TB/s、GPUごとに400G Ultra Ethernet NIC、FP64理論317 PFLOPS、FP8理論20 EFLOPS、FP4推論理論40 EFLOPSと掲載しています。各nodeには24 TB超のNVMeがあり、600 PB超のOrion Lustreへ接続し、SlurmとKubernetesを支援します。これらは公開仕様・理論値であり、acceptance、HPL/HPCG/MLPerf、app性能、稼働率、消費電力の実測ではありません。
items.statement_en: OLCF's system page describes Lux as more than 500 nodes and 4,000 AMD MI355X GPUs, with 1.1 PB total HBM, 288 GB and 8 TB/s per GPU, one 400G Ultra Ethernet NIC per GPU, and theoretical totals of 317 PFLOPS FP64, 20 EFLOPS FP8, and 40 EFLOPS FP4 inference. Each node has more than 24 TB NVMe and connects to the Orion Lustre system with more than 600 PB, while supporting Slurm and Kubernetes. These are public specifications and theoretical figures, not acceptance, HPL/HPCG/MLPerf, application, utilization, or measured power results.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: 数千GPU級でもlocal NVMe、shared file system、batch、service schedulerを組み合わせる構成例です。HPCI案ではGPU数だけでなくallocatable job、persistent service、data再利用、security区分を同じsystem specに含める必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: This is an example of combining local NVMe, shared storage, batch, and service schedulers at multi-thousand-GPU scale. HPCI designs should specify allocatable jobs, persistent services, data reuse, and security tiers alongside GPU count.
adoption_conditions_ja: acceptance結果、実効network bisection、I/O、application scaling、wall powerと冷却を確認する。
SlurmとKubernetesの資源分割、GPU sharing、network/storage QoS、accountingを確認する。
full-system規模と通常利用者が実際に割り当て可能な最大job規模を分けて表示する。
adoption_conditions_en: Verify acceptance, effective network bisection, I/O, application scaling, wall power, and cooling.
Verify Slurm/Kubernetes partitioning, GPU sharing, network/storage QoS, and accounting.
Display full-system scale separately from the maximum job actually allocatable to ordinary users.

items.name_en: Minimum commitment of 175,000 node-hours over six months
items.timing_ja: partner利用条件として公開、一般allocation条件は別途確認
items.timing_en: Published for partner access; general-allocation terms require separate confirmation
items.statement_ja: Lux頁はpartner向けに6か月当たり最低175,000 node-hoursを求め、例として400 node・3,200 GPUを18日、または約40 nodeを6か月連続で利用できる規模と説明します。full-system jobはpersistent service用node等により4,000 GPU未満となる場合があるとも注記しています。このcommitmentは一般公募の最小jobや全利用者の提供条件ではなく、料金も公開頁から確認できません。
items.statement_en: The Lux page requires partners to commit at least 175,000 node-hours over six months, illustrated as 400 nodes and 3,200 GPUs for 18 days or about 40 nodes continuously for six months. It also notes that full-system jobs may be limited to fewer than 4,000 GPUs because nodes can be dedicated to persistent services. This commitment is not a minimum job size or universal access term for all users, and public pricing was not verified.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: system所有規模、通常job上限、長期reservation、service常駐分を分ける必要性を示します。HPCIでもnode-hoursだけでなくGPU-hours、予約幅、期間、優先度、未使用分を契約化すべきです。
items.hpci_relevance_en: It illustrates the need to separate installed scale, ordinary job limits, long reservations, and persistent-service capacity. HPCI should contract GPU-hours, reservation width, duration, priority, and unused capacity rather than node-hours alone.
adoption_conditions_ja: node定義、GPU/node、最低commitment、料金、取消、未使用分、queue priorityを明示する。
persistent serviceとbatch利用のcapacity reservationを可視化する。
export-controlled、PHI等のsecurity区分ごとに利用可能resourceとdata経路を確認する。
adoption_conditions_en: Define nodes, GPUs per node, minimum commitments, prices, cancellation, unused capacity, and queue priority.
Make capacity reservations for persistent services and batch use visible.
Verify resources and data paths available to each security tier, including export-controlled and PHI use.
